name: Lexston Mining Corporation
summary: Lexston Mining Corporation engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties in Canada. The company holds a 100% interest in the Dory property located in the west of Port Alberni of British Columbia; and holds agreement of 100% interest in the Project Itza covering an area of 5,661.93 hectares of uranium deposits located in the Thelon Basin in Nunavut. The company is based in Vancouver, Canada.
